title: EtherChannel Basics
description: Combine multiple physical links into one logical link for more bandwidth and redundancy.
scenario: Combine multiple physical links into one logical link for more bandwidth and redundancy.

concepts.title: What is EtherChannel?
concepts.body: EtherChannel bundles up to 8 physical links into one logical link. Provides more bandwidth and redundancy.

concepts.title: Modes
concepts.body: active (LACP), passive (LACP), desirable (PAgP), auto (PAgP), on (static). LACP is the open standard.
concepts.code:
LACP:  active / passive
PAgP:  desirable / auto
Static: on

concepts.title: Verifying EtherChannel
concepts.body: "show etherchannel summary" shows the port-channel status and member ports.
concepts.code:
SW1# show etherchannel summary
Group  Port-channel  Protocol  Ports
1      Po1(SU)      LACP      Fa0/1(P) Fa0/2(P)
